# Draft patient scheduling emails

I run a solo practice that currently spends about 6 admin hours per week on scheduling and lose roughly 2–3 clinical hours to coordination. I have a $1,200/month budget and am hiring a part‑time virtual assistant (10‑15 hrs/week) to handle scheduling and patient communications. Draft three concise email templates: (1) appointment confirmation, (2) cancellation with re‑booking link, (3) reminder for missing information. Each template should be under 150 words and include placeholders for patient name, date, and provider. Return the three templates separated by headings.
